text_block_list.text:
Today, the tryouts—a multitude of races
highlighting up-and-coming
students—are
being held. This is their chance to get
scouted and
make it big.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's still early in the morning, but as I look
over at the track, I spy a
student already
running laps.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Whew! Okay, one more lap—no, ten more
laps!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list:
Be careful not to overwork yourself right before
the tryouts.

text_block_list.text:
No worries! So far, this has been nothing
more than a warm-up!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
After all, I'm Эль Кондор Паса! The racer
whose wings are destined to
unfurl and
soar across the world some day!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Wait! We're totally talkin' like we know
each other... Who are you?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса
choice_data_list:
I'm just a trainer who's here to watch the
tryouts.

text_block_list.text: You're a Тренер?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, then could it be... that
you've come here to scout
me?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The tryouts haven't even started yet, and
you're telling me you've
already got your
eye on my ability, talent, and potential?!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Bueno! I'm glad you came to say hi! I
respect your passion and drive!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: She's not hearing me out!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, I have to decline your offer
for now.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
...Why, you ask? Even though you want to
scout me right now, why do
I not accept
your offer?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: The answer is simple! Trainer, I want you to watch me today! Watch me in today's tryouts, and then judge my abilities!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
A passionate bond of trust with her trainer
is necessary for the world's
strongest racer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That's why I want you to judge me
properly, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
...Oh, but you didn't call out to me before
the tryouts in vain! ♪ I'll
give you one El
point for your troubles!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Whoa! It's almost time for my race. Catch
ya later—ciao! ♪
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса's feet take flight as she
dashes away, leaving me
behind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Finally, the tryouts begin in earnest.
There, the top-performing runner
is...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эль Кондор Паса! She's taken the lead!
Nobody can catch up!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
What magnificent form! In first place, El
Condor Pasa!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
La victoria! I'm the best, the greatest, the
one to beat all the rest!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
She left her competition in the dust in the
final stretch! She's head
and shoulders
above the competition!
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Why, we might just have a prodigy in the
making on our hands!
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B

text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... I can hear it—the crowd
cheerin' for the world's strongest
racer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
All right, it's scouting time! Which one of
you trainers wants to
conquer the world
with me?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Эль Кондор Паса! Please let me scout you!
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
No wait, pick me! I'll give you the wings
you need to fly!
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B

text_block_list.text:
Ooh, bueno! ♪ Now that's what I like to
hear!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: But what I'm lookin' for is a partner I can trust! Which means...
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
A duel! A contest! It's time for the
Scouting Championship!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: The Scouting Championship?
text_block_list.name: Trainers

text_block_list.text:
Sí! When it comes to trainers, it's their
training programs that count!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I want each of you to come up
with a training program fit
for me—the
world's strongest racer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And if I vibe enough with one of your
programs, then I'll accept the
scoutin'
offer from the trainer who came up with it!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I see... It's a training program showdown!
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer B

text_block_list.text:
Challenge accepted! I'll come up with the
perfect program for you!
text_block_list.name: Veteran Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
The trainers around Эль Кондор Паса soon
disperse, leaving only me
standing in front
of her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And lastly, we have... you! The trainer who
was overflowing with
passion!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
How-ever! Unfortunately for you, I'm not
giving you special treatment.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
That said... just between you and me, I'm
really lookin' forward to
whatever training
program you come up with! ♪
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: You did cut the line and try to scout me before I even raced, after all.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I expect great things, Trainer!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And so, I get to work drafting up a training
program for El Condor
Pasa.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
